column3: BSB follows the critical text with no “pure.” “The angel” is added; BSB runs the sentence on into verse 2 (“down the middle of the main street”).
“Twelve kinds of fruit” renders “twelve fruits”; “a fresh crop for each month” renders “according to each month yielding its fruit.”
“Within the city” renders “in it”; “worship” renders λατρεύσουσιν (“serve”).
Close to the Greek.
BSB follows the critical text with “the light of a lamp.” “In the city” is added; “shine on” renders φωτίσει.
BSB follows the critical text with “the God of the spirits of the prophets” (the Textus Receptus has “of the holy prophets”). “The angel” is added.
Close to the Greek.
Close to the Greek.
“Do not do that” renders “see that you [do] not.”
Close to the Greek.
BSB follows the critical text with “continue to practice righteousness” (the Textus Receptus has “be righteous still”). “Vile” renders ῥυπαρὸς (“filthy”).
“According to what he has done” renders “as his work is.”
BSB follows the critical-text order “the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
BSB follows the critical text with “wash their robes” (the Textus Receptus has “do His commandments”).
Close to the Greek.
“Give you this testimony for the churches” recasts “testify to you these things in the churches.”
“Drink” renders λαβέτω (“take”).
“Described” renders γεγραμμένας (“written”).
BSB follows the critical text with “the tree of life” (the Textus Receptus has “the book of life”). “Share” renders μέρος.
BSB follows the critical text with no second “yes.”
BSB has “with all the saints. Amen”: “the saints” follows other manuscripts (the critical text has “with all”), and “Amen” is in the Textus Receptus.
